text: Routine. Leah has the same routine before every heat.
Focus. Music helps me focus.
Energy. She eats a banana to get energy.
Breathe. Close your eyes and breathe slowly.
Muscles. She jogs to warm up her muscles.
Prepare. She uses the last hour to prepare her mind.
Distraction. The crowd is a big distraction.
Hydrated. Drink a lot of water to stay hydrated.

Renato, great heat this morning. Second place, you advanced! Your quarterfinal is at two, so here's the plan for the next three hours. First, eat something now, so that you have energy at two and your stomach isn't full in the water. A sandwich and some fruit, not a big pie. Then go and sit in the shade under the club tent, to get out of the sun and stay hydrated. Drink a full bottle of water before one o'clock. At one fifteen, come and find me. We're going to watch heat one together, in order to see where the sets are breaking in the afternoon. The tide is going to be higher, so the peak moves a little. And at one thirty, jog and stretch to warm up your muscles. After that, no phone. Just breathe and focus. Okay? Go eat.

So you want to know my routine? Okay. On heat day I wake up really early, to check the waves before everybody else. I always eat the same breakfast, eggs on toast, so that my stomach feels normal. I write my heat time on my hand with a pen, so that I don't forget it. Yeah, I forgot it once, and I nearly missed my heat. Then, an hour before, I give my phone to Jess, so that I can't look at it. The phone is my biggest distraction. And in the last five minutes I sit on my board in the shallow water, to feel the ocean before the horn. That's it. Today it didn't work, but it usually does. Steal it if you want.
